name: Sabilla "Sibby" Ball (Bradley)
sources: Hawkins County, Tennessee, County Court Minutes, April 1874–December 1877, pp. 248–251 (Monday 6 Sep 1875: Zadock Barnard and others v. Harden Ball and others, bill for partition, and In the matter of Hardin Ball, administrator, v. the heirs of Wm Ball; the heirs' agreement of 23 Aug 1875); FamilySearch images 3:1:3QHV-63CD-V8LW and 3:1:3QHV-63CD-VZH7
